analysis:
Examined the add-on hold socket server (AddonIPCServer.swift), the hold lifecycle (ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift) and the native MiMo load fence (ProviderLoop+NativeMiMo.swift:251). Relevant threats: T-059 (local DoS via hold) and TB-012. No concrete regressions identified. AddonIPCServer changes (lines 136-155): the peer is now verified with the audit token at accept time, before a connection takes one
of the 8 slots. Unauthenticated peers are refused and closed without consuming a slot, which improves T-059. Per-request re-verification is retained (206-214). A 10s requestTimeout (lines 167-185) bounds slow-trickle lines, so slowloris-style slot holding is now limited. The refusal write is bounded by writeTimeout (5s) but runs inline on the accept thread. A malicious same-UID peer that never reads could stall accept for up to 5s per connection. The refusal response is tiny, so the socket buffer should absorb it and the risk is low. Verification on the accept thread also calls the authenticator, whose cost is not visible. Residual: an unauthenticated peer can still cause log spam at warning level (log in verifiedPeer, line 219). AddonHold changes: cancelRequestsOutlivingAddonHoldDrain (282-292) replaces cancelAllInflight with a targeted cancellation. It checks ownsAddonHold per iteration and skips engineV2 recovery pins. The effect is that recovery-pin tracking is not cleared. Whether those pins hold memory or models beyond the hold is not visible. The tradeoff is bounded by the later unload sweep. unloadAllModelsForAddonHold now waits indefinitely on isLoadingAny (314-317), but exits if the hold is lost. A wedged load could keep the hold in the draining state indefinitely and never mark it held. The status is still draining, so routing is closed and failure is fail-closed. This is an availability concern rather than a security regression. addonHoldLoadRefusal (340) fences loads while any hold is active. The NativeMiMo hook is added at the publish point. Other load paths, such as the generic model load and EngineV2 paths, are outside the supplied evidence. The Next pass should confirm they also call addonHoldLoadRefusal. Unverified: the definitions of addonHoldSettleTimeout, addonHoldBeforeCancellingStragglersForTesting, and isLoadingAny (instance properties in other files); the testing hook must be test-only.
